title: In Apache James server prior version 3.9.1 improper Access Control List processing is exposed by the JMAP protocol…
description: Apache James server versions prior to 3.9.1 have an improper Access Control List (ACL) processing vulnerability in the JMAP protocol. This flaw arises because the JMAP protocol does not correctly handle negative ACL rules set by the IMAP protocol, allowing users to administer folders despite explicit denial of rights in IMAP. Upgrading to version 3.9.1 resolves this issue.
